protocol: continual_knowledge_learning_v1: Block-3 minimal experiment. K rules presented in sequence; belief_consolidation accumulates Dirichlet confidence per (rule, identity) and freezes it in an auditable ledger once confident (later tasks cannot disturb it); belief_no_consolidation shares one belief across rules (no separation, pollution); neural_control is a sequential shared-encoder baseline. Criterion: consolidation retains all rules (mean >= 0.9) and beats no-consolidation by >= 0.3.
